title: Titik Kumpul
subject: a volunteer fire warden in a Glodok electronics mall in an orange vest and helmet who shoos three hundred stall owners out in the monthly drill, and at the assembly point finds the phone-case girl counting heads and saying one person is still missing: him
caption: UK 2-step garage, swung skippy 2-step beat with a shuffled snare. Deep rounded sub-bass playing syncopated bass line, Rhodes electric piano on warm minor-seventh chords, soft synth pad underneath, crisp finger-snaps and light shaker. Clean club mix, punchy shuffled snare, warm sub-bass. Female vocal, mid register, smooth and playful, melodic R&B singing with stacked backing harmonies, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, F minor. Flirty, bouncing mood. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap, no dubstep wobble, no four-on-the-floor house kick, no distorted guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes and shuffled 2-step drums]

[Verse 1]
Sabtu pagi bunyi sirene di lantai dua
Pria berompi oranye berdiri di tangga
Tiga ratus kios, semuanya pura-pura tuli
Ada yang masih menghitung uang di laci

[Pre-Chorus]
Ayo keluar, ayo keluar
Ini cuma latihan, tapi tetap jalan

[Chorus]
Di titik kumpul aku menghitung kepala
Satu, dua, tiga, kok kurang satu orang
Di titik kumpul semua sudah di luar
Yang belum keluar cuma kamu, Pak Petugas

[Verse 2]
Kamu periksa kios sampai ujung koridor
Kamu cek stopkontak dan tabung pemadam
Kamu lupa periksa jalan keluar buat dirimu
Aku pegang daftar nama, jariku mulai gelisah

[Pre-Chorus]
Kamu muncul dengan helm miring
Aku pura-pura marah, padahal senyum

[Chorus]
Di titik kumpul aku menghitung kepala
Satu, dua, tiga, sekarang sudah lengkap
Di titik kumpul bunyi sirene berhenti
Latihan lagi bulan depan, jangan terlambat

[Outro - Rhodes and sub-bass fade]
